_about: Outcast Fortress (levels 15-32): grey wolves in the deep forest on the way in; exile scouts in the light forest, the outpost and at the barricade; outcast brigands in the courtyard, along the mountain wall, in the tunnels and the Grieving Griffon; deserter soldiers holding the keep; feral exiles in the dark, damp tunnels; and Yarick the Outcast, who built the place, in his quarters in the keep.

44290.description: A broad, heavy sword with a blade notched by a hundred fights, its pommel a lump of raw iron. Yarick cut his way out of exile with it.

44291.description: A thick mantle of grey wolf pelts, clasped with a brooch shaped like a broken chain: the outcasts' sign.

44200.name: yarick outcast bandit warlord
44200.long_desc: Yarick the Outcast, a scarred bandit warlord, rises from his desk with a broadsword in hand.
44200.description: A big, grizzled man in patched mail under a mantle of wolf fur, a brand of exile burned into one cheek. He built this fortress for the cast-out and the hunted, and when the others fled or hid, he stayed to hold it.

phases.message: Yarick spits blood and roars: 'This fortress is mine! You will not take it!'

abilities.name: Exile's Cleave
abilities.telegraph: Yarick draws his notched broadsword back for a sweeping cut!

abilities.name: Pommel Crack
abilities.telegraph: Yarick reverses his grip and lunges with the pommel!

abilities.name: Last Stand
abilities.telegraph: Yarick plants his feet and bellows a war cry!

44201.name: wolf grey forest
44201.long_desc: A grey forest wolf slips between the ancient trunks, watching you with yellow eyes.
44201.description: A lean grey wolf of the deep forest, ribs showing under a winter coat. The packs here have learned that travellers on the fortress path are slow and alone.

44202.name: exile scout outcast
44202.long_desc: An exile scout crouches in the ferns, a bow half drawn.
44202.description: A wiry figure in a mottled green cloak, a short bow in hand and an exile's brand on the back of one hand. The scouts still watch the way in, though there is less and less to guard.

44203.name: brigand outcast bandit
44203.long_desc: An outcast brigand lounges here, a hand never far from his axe.
44203.description: A hard-faced brigand in a patchwork of stolen leather, an axe through his belt and a broken-chain brooch at his throat. Every man here was thrown out of somewhere; few of them were thrown out for nothing.

44204.name: deserter soldier mercenary
44204.long_desc: A deserter soldier stands guard here in a faded tabard with the badge cut away.
44204.description: A trained soldier in battered mail, the badge of whatever army he fled torn from his tabard. Yarick pays the deserters to hold the keep, and they hold it well.

44205.name: exile feral outcast
44205.long_desc: A feral exile crouches in the dark, gnawing on something.
44205.description: Once a man, cast out so long ago he has forgotten speech: matted hair, bare filthy feet, nails like claws and a sharpened bone in his fist. He lives in the tunnels and hunts whatever comes down.

bosses.why: Yarick the Outcast in Yarick's Quarters in the keep: the fortress's founder, who stayed when the others fled
